recognize_zh: 中倍下骨小樑旁有一大片細胞質淡紫、核圓且染色質細緻的較大細胞聚集，與周圍含許多嗜酸性球、成熟顆粒球及紅血球的骨髓分界清楚；大型未成熟紅系前驅細胞群配合嗜酸性球增加，提示 PCM1::JAK2 相關骨髓腫瘤。
features: Large sheet-like aggregate of medium to large immature cells with round nuclei and pale amphophilic cytoplasm
Aggregates adjacent to bony trabeculae and relatively well demarcated from surrounding marrow
Background marrow with maturing granulocytes including numerous eosinophils
describe_en: Medium-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows a large, relatively well-demarcated aggregate of medium to large immature cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin and pale amphophilic cytoplasm adjacent to a bony trabecula. The surrounding marrow contains maturing granulocytes with conspicuous eosinophils, scattered megakaryocytes and interstitial red cells. The lineage of the aggregate cannot be established on H&E alone, but glycophorin C immunostaining identifies these as immature erythroid precursors. The combination of expanded immature erythroid islands and eosinophilia is consistent with myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PCM1::JAK2.

ddx.vs: AML blasts are CD34/CD117/MPO positive and glycophorin negative, and blasts count toward at least 20% in marrow.
Requires more than 80% erythroid cells with at least 30% proerythroblasts, whereas here the erythroid islands are admixed with abundant granulopoiesis and eosinophils.
Mast cell aggregates are paratrabecular with spindled cells, eosinophil rims and fibrosis, and are tryptase/CD117/CD25 positive.
Lymphoma cells are CD45 and CD20 or CD3 positive, glycophorin negative.
